name: tcg-ecommerce
description: TCG E-Commerce Platform - Pokémon Card Store

scripts.//build: ALL generate/build steps are LOCAL-ONLY (never on the cPanel server — its LVE kills Prisma CLI's Wasm validation with an OOM).
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.//start: PRODUCTION RUNTIME — pure `node`, no prisma hooks, no generate, no migrate.
scripts.//local-db: Local dev DB (Docker/local MariaDB). Destructive commands stay local-only.
scripts.//remote-db-cpanel: Remote cPanel DB via LOCAL machine (scripts/remote-prisma.js). Safe ops only.
scripts.docker:migrate: docker compose --profile migrate up --exit-code-from migrate migrate
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose --profile seed up --exit-code-from seed seed
scripts.//deploy: cPanel pipeline: local build -> zip -> upload -> extract -> npm install -> start. See DEPLOY_CPANEL.md.
